raw_response:
Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-rays and CT scan demonstrate an ill-defined, patchy parenchymal consolidation in the left lower lobe. In a patient with persistent infiltrates that do not resolve with antibiotic treatment, this radiographic appearance is highly characteristic of Bronchiolitis Obliterans Organizing Pneumonia (BOOP), also known as Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP).
